fields.description: Program Description ■ Length of Study At least 2.5 years (1 year courses learning, 0.5 year or more internship, 1 year thesis) ■ Cultivation objective: A firm grasp of the basic theory and systematic professional knowledge of software engineering and computer science. Be familiar with and master research trends, advanced technical methods and technical means in the professional field. Have the ability to engage in scientific research, teaching or specialized technical work. ■ Course Mathematical statistics & application Numerical analysis Literature review and academic seminars Advanced software engineering Object-oriented system analysis and design(Java) Software process improvement and management(CMM) Embedded software development(C++) Advanced project training Advanced Java programming Service computing Data warehouse and data mining Advanced artificial intelligence Mobile cloud computing Network and information security technology Virtual reality and human interaction technology Chinese language Chinese culture ■ Research Area Future Internet Cloud Computing Service Computing Big Data Analytics Network and Information Security Participatory Sensing Digital Media Processing

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form Please upload your finished application form here. 2. Guardian's letter of guarantee (just for applicants under 18 years old) You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Non-Criminal record report You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Physical examination record for foreigner You can download a template or sample from here . 5. If you are in China now, you need to submit all the Chinese visa pages, Chinese entry stamp and Chinese exit stamp pages of your passport (Please note the time continuity of the visa pages.) And Registration Form of Temporary Residence for Visitors from Overseas. * 6. Study plan at NEU No less than 800 words in Chinese or English. Please elaborate on the major or research orientation you plan to study at NEU. * 7. Blank visa page of passport * 8. English Language test result * 9. Passport photo Three recent passport-sized photos of the applicant * 10. Home page of passport * 11. Transcript of high school and its Chinese translation According to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: academic transcript in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 12. Graduation certificate of high school and its Chinese translation According to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen in good health. If both parents or one of them is a Chinese citizen and has settled in a foreign country, and the applicant has a foreign nationality at birth to apply for undergraduate program study in China, the applicant must have a record of having lived in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the recent 4 years (up to April 30).The actual living abroad for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamp of passport. If Chinese citizens who have emigrated to other countries apply to study in China as foreign students, they must hold a valid foreign passport or foreign nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive) and must have lived in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the recent 4 years (up to April 30). The actual living abroad for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamp of passport. 2. Graduate certificate of high school level or above. 3. Over 17 years old. 4. English major and programs taught in English, your mother/official language should be English or you need to provide English proficiency test certificates such as IELTS or TOFEL.
